{{Quote|With the increasing threat of the Rebels attacking our research facility here in Restuss, we need to ramp up our defensive forces.|Lieutenant [[Pofko]]|<ref name="SWG:LoW" />}}
A secret [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]<ref name="CtA">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=66905&resource=features|text=''Call to Arms, Aid the Rebellion!''}}</ref> '''research facility''' was located in the city of [[Restuss]],<ref name="SWG:LoW" /> on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Empire developed a new power source with an unimaginable energy supply capacity called the [[Star Core]] in the Restuss research facility.<ref name="CtA" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] discovered the project and targeted the city of Restuss.<ref name="CtA" /> In the ensuing [[Battle of Restuss]], the Star Core exploded and completely destroyed Restuss.<ref name="RiR" />
